invalid-range.label: Invalid range handling
invalid-range.description: A lower bound above the upper bound is accepted instead of rejected.

off-by-one.label: Off-by-one
off-by-one.description: One of the boundaries is clamped to the wrong value.

swapped-bounds.label: Swapped bounds
swapped-bounds.description: Out-of-range values are clamped to the wrong end of the range.
